relationships.subject: dopamine
relationships.evidence_quote: We show that dopamine, through D1 receptor (D1R) signaling, inhibits pyramidal neurons of mouse ACC by modulation of hyperpolarization-activated cyclic nucleotide-gated (HCN) channels

relationships.subject: D1R
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of G<sub>s</sub>-coupled D1R by dopamine induces the opening of HCN channels at physiological membrane potentials, driving a significant decrease in input resistance and excitability

relationships.subject: SKF81297
relationships.evidence_quote: Application of 10 μM SKF81297 induced a strong, reversible inhibition of layer 2/3 pyramidal cells in the ACC

relationships.subject: quinpirole
relationships.evidence_quote: we found a significant increase in excitability in comparison to aCSF controls

relationships.subject: L-DOPA
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic L-DOPA in chronic neuropathic mice rescues HCN channel activity, normalizes pyramidal excitability in ACC, and blocks mechanical and thermal allodynia

relationships.subject: L-DOPA
relationships.evidence_quote: Systemic L-DOPA in chronic neuropathic mice rescues HCN channel activity, normalizes pyramidal excitability in ACC, and blocks mechanical and thermal allodynia

relationships.subject: SKF81297
relationships.evidence_quote: microinjection of a selective D1R agonist in the ACC relieves the aversiveness of ongoing neuropathic pain, while an ACC D1R antagonist blocks gabapentin- and lidocaine-evoked antinociception

relationships.subject: SCH23390
relationships.evidence_quote: Addition of SCH23390 by pre-incubation and co-application blocks both the inhibitory effect of 50 μM DA (Figure 2A) and the DA-induced decrease in input resistance

relationships.subject: ZD7288
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with 10 μM ZD7288 completely abolishes DAergic inhibition in the ACC

key_findings: Dopamine inhibits ACC layer 2/3 and 5 pyramidal neurons via Gs-coupled D1R that shifts HCN channel activation depolarized, lowering input resistance; D2-like activation increases excitability.

Systemic L-DOPA in SNI mice restores ACC HCN currents, normalizes pyramidal excitability and blocks allodynia; ACC D1R agonism relieves ongoing pain aversiveness and ACC D1R blockade prevents gabapentin/lidocaine pain relief.
